series_start_reason: FDA approval 30 Jul 2021; the Q3 2021 results (0001654954-21-012039) print the first Saphnelo row (1 for the quarter and the year to date, all in the US column). The Q2 2021 release prints no Saphnelo sales row.
notes: Every row is the first (World) column of the Saphnelo line in the Product Sales table (BioPharmaceuticals, Respiratory & Immunology) of that quarter's own release. Annual sums of the quarters equal the full-year figures printed in the Q4 releases: 2021 8, 2022 116, 2023 280, 2024 474, 2025 686. Launch quarter is not stated by quarter in an issuer document, so launch_quarter is null.
search_log: Listed every AstraZeneca PLC (CIK 0000901832) filing via data.sec.gov submissions (recent plus older pages; 2,052 filings, all form types).

Downloaded the main document of all 1,646 filings of form 6-K, 6-K/A, 20-F and 20-F/A that carry a primary document (2002-2026) and scanned them: HTML table rows by label, plain text for the 2002-2003 .txt releases; 2002 6-Ks before November 2002 are scanned paper documents (.paper) and were not readable.
Latest results document used: the Q2 2026 results 6-K filed 2026-07-27 (0001104659-26-086846); no later results release exists as of the search date.
Bigdata.com was available but not needed; every figure was read from the sec.gov original, never from a Bigdata.com link.
Saphnelo rows: located in every results release Q3 2021-Q2 2026 (20 quarters, no gaps); Q4 values cross-checked against the full-year figures in the same releases.
Q1-Q2 2021 releases: no Saphnelo sales row (the Q3 2021 release prints dashes for Q1 and Q2 2021 in its quarterly history table).
